lines.1: 「I'm off, then. I'm here from the general direction of the fire department!」
lines.2: 「At least ring the doorbell... Oh, right. You're supposed to be a yokai.」
lines.3: 「(Now, what should I say to scare him?)」
lines.4: 「(Maybe I should go with, 'I have appeeeared' after all.)」
lines.10: I pulled off the sheet, and it was just Crab.
lines.11: 「Entering a home without even ringing the bell...」
lines.12: 「I understand you are childhood friends, but even the closest relationship requires manners.」
lines.13: 「You made me land a palm-heel strike on your jaw at an excellent angle.」
lines.16: 「So what exactly is going on here?」
lines.17: 「When did you get here? Well, whatever. The thing is...」
